title: lunarg-block
body:
![minecraft players fear these](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43bb34b1b914a2d5dc7a66b8f7d5a52c8a4bc002.jpeg)

Adds a block craftable from 9 vulkan triangles which scares minecraft players.

I've decided to create this silly little mod after stumbling upon a funny tweet in my twitter timeline. This is actually an insanely useless mod :D
